capabilities: Open .xml files in a dedicated read-only view
Browse XML as a tree showing elements, attributes, namespaces and node paths
Filter nodes by element names, attributes, text, comments and CDATA
Switch to a source view with line numbers and syntax highlighting
Report malformed XML and capped large-file renders without crashing
extras: Strictly read-only by design and never writes back to XML files; renders only the first 10,000 nodes of large files. The directory listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows XML files as raw text, so inspecting structured XML like SOAP payloads or config exports means leaving the vault or squinting at unformatted markup.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .xml files as a searchable tree or syntax-highlighted source view with parse warnings.
